elastic_net.features: V0 with training medians, missing indicators and standardization

rules.weights: fixed equal weights within each rule
rules.normalization: within-date centered midrank on observed values, minus1 to1
rules.universe: all source feature rows on evaluation dates before any label join
rules.cutoff: one as_of per date; available_at <= as_of for all peers
rules.units: dimensionless score; never a return or probability
rules.evaluation: ranking metrics only, no MSE against raw returns

comparison: all original 18 candidates, exact development keys/folds; preserve v1/v2 and learned-ensemble receipts
